governance.feature_grain: inspection interval, unless explicitly stated otherwise
governance.point_in_time_rule: A feature may use only source facts with business time at or before its score/interval end time.
governance.blocked_value_rule: A BLOCKED feature must not be materialised as a numerical estimate or silently imputed.
governance.source_of_truth: Feature readiness is governed by this specification; physical-distance policy is docs/rtis_distance_semantics.md.

status_definitions.READY: Released and permitted in an approved product at the stated grain and caveats.
status_definitions.READY_WITH_CAVEAT: Released factual context; use is limited by an explicit semantic caveat.
status_definitions.READY_FOR_MATERIALISATION: Verified source and formula exist, but no product column has yet been released.
status_definitions.PENDING: Expected feature with a known implementation or validation task remaining.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Must not be calculated until named dependencies are approved.
status_definitions.FUTURE: Requires a source or capability not presently available.

features.name: Inspection interval duration
features.engineering_meaning: Elapsed calendar time between two attributable wheelset/equipment measurements.
features.consumer_limit: Duration is not evidence of locomotive operation or distance.

features.name: Point-in-time assignment quality
features.engineering_meaning: Whether a measurement has exactly one effective-dated equipment-to-locomotive assignment.
features.formula: timeline_quality_tier emitted by Business Truth v1.0
validation_rules: Gold B requires exactly one valid assignment interval
Gold C records are excluded from high-confidence features
features.consumer_limit: wsmEquipmentId remains equipment/wheelset-candidate identity pending business-semantic confirmation.

features.name: Raw endpoint diameter change
features.grain: one inspection interval and measured side
features.engineering_meaning: Observed endpoint difference in the recorded diameter field; not yet an approved wear measure.
features.unit: source measurement unit, engineering unit confirmation pending
validation_rules: retain sign and do not clip
features.consumer_limit: Do not label as wear or use as a health score until measurement units, turning and replacement semantics are approved.

features.name: RTIS source-event count
features.engineering_meaning: Count of timestamped records from the RTIS emergency-event source in the interval.
features.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT IrledId WHERE start < EVENT_TRANSMISSION_TIME <= end AND normalised LOCO_NO matches)
features.consumer_limit: Event-code engineering meaning is pending; do not claim an individual code proves braking or a wheel mechanism.

features.name: Maintenance job-card creation count
features.engineering_meaning: Number of job cards created for the assigned locomotive in the interval.
features.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT SejId WHERE start < SejCreatedOn <= end AND SejLocoId matches)
validation_rules: valid locomotive ID and creation timestamp
features.consumer_limit: Creation is not completion, effectiveness, wheel specificity, or a turning/replacement event.

features.name: RTIS reporting coverage
features.engineering_meaning: Share of interval days with one or more RTIS mileage-source reports.
features.formula: 100 * distinct RTIS report dates in interval / interval_days
validation_rules: dates must be source report dates
features.consumer_limit: Coverage measures reporting presence only; it is not a measure of kilometres, movement, route coverage or utilisation.

features.name: Static locomotive axle-load configuration
features.engineering_meaning: Configured static axle load of the locomotive class, not hauled-train or dynamic load.
features.unit: source unit; engineering confirmation required before display
features.consumer_limit: Never represent as time-varying hauled-train load or wheel-rail contact load.

features.name: Raw turning indicator
features.engineering_meaning: Source turning fields recorded with a wheel measurement.
validation_rules: domain owner must define values, timing and relation to actual turning/reprofiling
features.consumer_limit: Do not reset wear history, calculate time since turning, or infer intervention effectiveness.

features.name: Engineering wear rate per day
features.grain: one measurement side and inspection interval
features.engineering_meaning: Physical material loss rate across a validated non-intervened interval.
features.consumer_limit: No numerical output or training label is permitted.

features.name: Physical distance travelled
features.engineering_meaning: Physical locomotive travel attributable to the interval.
features.formula: owner-approved mileage aggregation or validated movement ledger
dependencies: RTIS distance semantics approval or validated alternative movement ledger

features.name: Engineering wear rate per kilometre
features.grain: one measurement side and inspection interval
features.engineering_meaning: Material loss normalised by attributable physical travel.
features.consumer_limit: No numerical output or training label is permitted.

features.name: Historical weather exposure
features.engineering_meaning: Aggregated weather context over validated time/location observations.
features.formula: provider-defined aggregation of temperature, precipitation and humidity over validated movement locations/times
features.consumer_limit: Supporting context only; never a causal conclusion.

features.name: Track curve/gradient severity
features.engineering_meaning: Route-segment physical severity based on authoritative curvature and gradient.
features.formula: distance-weighted approved curve/gradient function over mapped track segments
dependencies: released interval distance or segment exposure rule
features.consumer_limit: Open/GIS data may support research only until engineering validation.

features.name: Explainable wheel health index
features.engineering_meaning: Engineering-approved summary of measured geometry, degradation and maintenance state.
features.formula: versioned rule or calibrated model over released State, Degradation and Maintenance features
features.consumer_limit: No numerical output is permitted until the dependencies are released. It is not a prediction, maintenance directive or failure diagnosis.
